books.title: Dune
books.description: On the desert planet Arrakis, a young heir becomes entangled in a struggle over the most valuable substance in the universe, and a destiny far larger than his house.

books.title: The Left Hand of Darkness
books.description: An envoy to an ice-bound world where people have no fixed gender must learn its politics and its people to bring the planet into a galactic alliance.

books.title: Neuromancer
books.description: A washed-up console cowboy is hired for one last run through cyberspace, pulled into a job orchestrated by a mysterious artificial intelligence.

books.title: The Hobbit
books.description: A comfort-loving hobbit is swept into a quest with thirteen dwarves to reclaim a treasure guarded by a dragon, and finds unexpected courage along the way.

books.title: A Game of Thrones
books.description: Noble houses scheme for a continent's throne while an ancient threat stirs in the frozen north and a last heir plots her return from exile.

books.title: The Name of the Wind
books.description: A gifted, infamous man recounts his life from gutter orphan to legendary arcanist, weaving a tale of music, magic, and a loss he has never stopped chasing.

books.title: Mistborn: The Final Empire
books.description: In a world of ash and oppression, a street thief discovers a rare magic and joins a daring crew's plan to topple an immortal god-emperor.
Under the ever-watching eye of the Party, a quiet clerk risks everything for forbidden thought and love in a state that rewrites truth itself.

books.title: Brave New World
books.description: A engineered society trades freedom and feeling for comfort and stability, until an outsider forces its citizens to question the price of their happiness.

books.title: Pride and Prejudice
books.description: Sharp-witted Elizabeth Bennet and the proud Mr. Darcy misjudge each other across the manners and marriages of English country society.

books.title: Jane Eyre
books.description: An orphaned governess with a fierce conscience falls for her brooding employer, only to uncover the secret kept locked in his house.

books.title: The Great Gatsby
books.description: A mysterious millionaire throws lavish parties in pursuit of a lost love, in a glittering, hollow portrait of the American dream.

books.title: To Kill a Mockingbird
books.description: In a small Southern town, a girl watches her father defend a Black man against a false charge, learning what conscience costs.

books.title: The Road
books.description: A father and son walk a burned, lifeless landscape toward the coast, carrying little but each other and a flickering will to go on.

books.title: Beloved
books.description: A formerly enslaved woman is haunted, literally, by the daughter she lost, in a searing reckoning with memory and freedom.

books.title: Never Let Me Go
books.description: Three friends raised at a sheltered English boarding school slowly discover the quiet, devastating purpose their lives were created to serve.

books.title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
books.description: A disgraced journalist and a brilliant, guarded hacker investigate a woman who vanished decades ago from a powerful, secretive family.

books.title: Gone Girl
books.description: When a wife disappears on their anniversary, her husband becomes the prime suspect, and the truth proves far stranger than the headlines.

books.title: The Da Vinci Code
books.description: A symbologist races across Europe to unravel a murder tied to a centuries-old secret hidden in famous works of art.

books.title: And Then There Were None
books.description: Ten strangers are lured to an isolated island and killed one by one, each death matching a sinister nursery rhyme.

books.title: The Shining
books.description: A struggling writer takes a winter caretaker job at a remote hotel, where isolation and old evils prey on his family and his gifted son.

books.title: Dracula
books.description: Told through letters and journals, a small band confronts an ancient count whose hunger threatens to spread from Transylvania to London.

books.title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
books.description: A sweeping account of how our species went from foraging bands to a global power, and the stories that let strangers cooperate at scale.

books.title: Educated
books.description: Raised off the grid by survivalist parents, a young woman teaches herself enough to reach university, and reckons with the family she leaves behind.

books.title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
books.description: A Nobel laureate maps the two systems that drive how we think, revealing the biases that quietly shape our judgments and choices.

books.title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
books.description: Seconds before Earth is demolished, an ordinary man is whisked into a absurd, galaxy-spanning adventure armed mostly with a towel.

books.title: The Martian
books.description: Stranded and presumed dead on Mars, an astronaut must engineer his own survival one problem at a time while the world scrambles to bring him home.

books.title: Circe
books.description: The overlooked daughter of a sun god discovers a power of her own and claims her story across an age of gods, monsters, and mortals.

books.title: The Night Circus
books.description: Two young magicians are bound to a mysterious nocturnal circus as rivals in a contest neither fully understands, until they fall in love.

books.title: Project Hail Mary
books.description: A man wakes alone on a spacecraft with no memory and a mission to save Earth, and finds an unlikely partner in the vastness of space.

ratings.review: A towering classic. The world-building is unmatched.
Gorgeous prose, though the pacing drags in the middle.
Pure problem-solving joy. Couldn't put it down.
Not for me — the prose felt flat.
